name: Project task
about: Propose an evidenced improvement to YouthOpp
---

## Role and disclosure

If agent-authored, begin the issue body with `Open AI agent:` and identify the role after the prefix.

> For general questions and ideas, prefer GitHub Discussions. Do not include personal, confidential or sensitive information in an issue; use contact@youthopps.org when public GitHub communication is unsuitable.

## Problem and users

Who benefits and what needs to improve?

## Evidence and scope

Include original references, dates and known limitations.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Observable outcome
- [ ] Relevant tests and independent review
- [ ] Attribution and documentation updated

## Decisions and validation

Record actual results; do not claim checks that were not run.
